evidence.title: Lebanon July 6 minutes - Meta/Orla campus under construction
evidence.publisher: City of Lebanon Board of Zoning Appeals
evidence.attribution: City of Lebanon Board of Zoning Appeals
evidence.excerpt: July 6 minutes identify Orla, Project Domino/Meta and one approximately 1,500-acre campus at 3602 W SR 32; the property is described as currently under construction for a multi-building Meta data center.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of exact content-decoded HTTP response-body bytes
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction and attribution only. Raw documents, government-hosted engineering plans, source HTML, basemaps, aerial imagery, personal contact details and bulk records remain temporary and are not redistributed. No open source-document or media licence is asserted.
metadata.publication_date_unknown_reason: The document gives the meeting date, not a verified online publication date. Its September meeting-page attachment and January URL folder do not change the observation date.
metadata.selected_observation_basis: The minutes repeat the planning official's statement at the July 6 meeting that the existing Meta campus is currently under construction. This is distinct from conditional approval of future telecommunications towers.
metadata.status_scope: Generic under_construction for one existing campus project only. Future DAS tower approval is not selected as physical work; no exact building count, power, capacity, roles, workload, commissioning or operating status is normalized.

independent_physical_corroboration.scope: IDEM field inspection pages 1, 3 and 4 explicitly describe Orla data-center excavation and soil stabilization. Its 3062 address differs from municipal 3602 and is not used for geometry.

metadata.successor_review: A September 8 bounded search of Meta first-party pages, city July minutes and staff report found no authoritative completion or cancellation successor through August 20. This is a bounded review, not proof of all future changes. The first-party February page and current portfolio listing still describe future completion; their retrieval does not refresh status.
